stem: Chlorine is one of the elements in Group 17 of the Periodic Table.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Describe the colours of the Group 17 elements, chlorine to iodine, at room temperature.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Describe the relative reactivity of the elements chlorine to iodine as oxidising agents.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: State what is observed when chlorine reacts with hydrogen.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.text: Explain why the thermal stability of the hydrogen halides decreases down the group.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: The halogenoalkane $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{Cl}$ forms when chlorine reacts with $\text{C}_2\text{H}_6$ via a free-radical substitution mechanism.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the essential condition for chlorine to react with $\text{C}_2\text{H}_6$ at room temperature.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Write **two** equations to show the propagation steps in this reaction.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
$\text{CHCl}_3$ is another halogenoalkane. $\text{CHCl}_3$ forms when propanone reacts with $\text{NaClO}$.

$\text{NaClO}$ is made from chlorine in a disproportionation reaction.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Identify a reagent and conditions that can be used to convert chlorine to $\text{NaClO}$.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
Write numbers in the boxes to balance the equation showing the reaction of propanone with $\text{NaClO}$.

$$\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3 + \square \text{NaClO} \rightarrow \square \text{CHCl}_3 + \square \text{CH}_3\text{COONa} + \square \text{NaOH}$$

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text:
Aqueous $\text{AgNO}_3$ dissolved in ethanol reacts with an aqueous solution of $\text{CHCl}_3$.

State what is observed in this reaction. Explain your answer.
